item.description:
Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 278)

  • Tab groups: Cmd+1…9 counts only the tabs you can see. Tabs inside a collapsed group are skipped. Previous/next tab (Cmd+Shift+[ / ]) still reaches tabs in a collapsed group and opens it.
  • Terminal: Command-click on any file opens the built-in preview (Markdown, text, images); folders open in Finder. A dot, comma or bracket after a path is ignored.
  • Downloads open in their own tab, without a Back to Page button.
  • Quieter when idle: fewer session saves and slower agent status checks while Devkitty is hidden. Claude Code no longer relaunches Devkitty every few seconds to report an unchanged status.
  • Bookmarks bar shows full names and scrolls sideways when they do not fit.
  • PR popover: GitHub-style comments (hidden HTML comments, collapsible details, alerts, task boxes, Show more), its own icon for each PR state, a robot icon and Autonomous badge for bot comments, and faster loading.
  • Browser back and forward buttons have a larger hit area. Open in External Browser closes the built-in tab.
  • Codex tabs no longer show the raw session ID as their name.
  • The mouse pointer hides while you type in the terminal.

Limitation: after a Force Quit or crash, up to half a second of title, folder or window-frame changes may not be restored.
